method: Same Chromium page, JSON and binary AOT, JS and Wasm. Rotated engine/operation order, 200 warmups then two calibration rounds targeting 20ms/sample, 7 samples. Pre-encoded binds, response JSON.parse and failure checks included. Every non-noop mutation changes a value; dedicated row per operation. Scan typed cells checked against native SQLite before and after timing; rejected writes leave the entire table unchanged. Initial PK/secondary-index reads precede timing; derived caches may be replaced by rejected writes in this mixed workload. No storage, RPC, load/compile costs or forced GC. Before artifacts are supplied explicitly and hashed; this is an optimization comparison, not a SQLite speed comparison.
